name: Linear Gradient Reconstruction
aliases: First-order Taylor expansion for gradient estimation
definition: A method to estimate the gradient $\nabla f(\mathbf{x}_0)$ of a scalar field $f$ discretized on an unstructured mesh by approximating the function value at a neighboring point $\mathbf{x}_0 + \mathbf{h}$ using a linear model.
summary: Linear Gradient Reconstruction estimates scalar field gradients via first-order Taylor expansion, distinguishing itself through regression-based residual minimization that outperforms averaging methods on irregular meshes.
